Kevin, saw Casepoint bring on Paul Colangelo as CEO, partner with Proofpoint, and clear CMMC Level 2.

Moves like that surface more in-market accounts than your team can realistically support, and that is where deals stall waiting on coverage. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so reach scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Casepoint off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Kevin, quick follow-up for Casepoint.

With new leadership and a fresh security credential, pipeline expectations usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Casepoint needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Kevin, last bit of proof for Casepoint.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Casepoint's reply rate likely compares to other legal-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
